profile.headline: SEO Specialist | Content Strategy | Digital Marketing Specialist | AI Agent Builder Enthusiast
profile.summary: SEO professional with 10+ years of experience combining search strategy, web development, and content management to drive sustainable organic growth. Proven ability to own SEO roadmaps end to end, optimize site architecture and templates, and scale content with technical precision. Experienced partnering with content, product, and engineering teams to ship SEO improvements that increase traffic, rankings, and conversions. Strong background in technical SEO, CMS-driven sites, analytics, and modern search trends including AI-driven discovery.

positions.title: Sr. SEO Analyst
positions.description:
Sr. SEO Analyst across a multi-client portfolio spanning e-commerce, hospitality, multi-location service brands, and local services

Manage technical SEO audits including site architecture reviews, URL structure analysis, schema audits, internal linking strategy, and full-site health crawls

Drive on-page optimization at scale: title tag and meta description rewrites for top-performing product and category pages, query-to-page alignment audits, and content consistency crawls

Own local SEO programs including Google Business Profile audits, local keyword research and benchmarking, service area definitions, local trust signal optimization, and GBP UTM tracking implementation

Manage ongoing GBP content calendars for a multi-property hospitality portfolio, scaling monthly post production through SOCi

Lead SEO launch playbooks for new property openings, covering on-site optimization, local search setup, and Travel Guide content programs targeting high-intent travel demand

Drive e-commerce SEO performance through Google Merchant Center feed audits, product feed accuracy reviews, category content architecture with FAQ implementation, and quick-win keyword targeting

Run performance analyses covering bounce rate by device, PDP performance, redirected collections, shopping performance post feed optimization, theme change impact, and backlink quality

Conduct AI search visibility analysis to benchmark performance across AI Overviews, Perplexity, and similar engines alongside traditional organic

Deliver non-brand keyword gap analysis, competitor analysis, specialty page strategy, and bilingual (Spanish) keyword research

Build and maintain reporting in Looker Studio, BrightEdge dashboards, and AccuRanker rank tracking

positions.title: SEO Specialist
positions.description:
Owned the Jobscan blog SEO roadmap to grow organic traffic and subscriptions, prioritizing work by impact and effort

Collaborated with cross-functional teams to align SEO strategy with business objectives, contributing to a 3x revenue increase and a 64% lift in organic traffic

Led comprehensive keyword research and SERP analysis to map intent, find content gaps, and build data-driven content plans

Optimized website content and technical SEO elements (titles, headings, internal linking, schema, crawl/indexation, redirects, canonicals) to improve rankings and CTR

Resolved critical SEO issues through regular audits, driving ongoing improvements in site health and search visibility

Partnered with writers, designers, and developers to ship SEO updates across templates and content at scale

Built and maintained reporting dashboards and KPI tracking, turning performance data into clear priorities and next steps

Monitored and analyzed performance using Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Screaming Frog, and CrazyEgg, delivering actionable insights and recommendations

Developed an AI agent in n8n to streamline SEO workflows and reporting, improving team efficiency and output

Tested and implemented AEO and LLM-discovery tactics (AI Overviews, ChatGPT-style answers) through structured content, entity optimization, and answer-focused formatting

Supported backlink and partnership initiatives to strengthen authority and increase referral traffic

positions.title: Search Engine Optimization Consultant
positions.locationName: San Juan, Puerto Rico, Puerto Rico
positions.description:
Managed end-to-end website projects from initial design and information architecture to development, deployment, and ongoing site management

Led SEO projects that moved client websites to page 1 of Google within 6 months for keywords with 300K+ search volume

Served as the primary SEO subject matter expert, developing internal tools, best practices, and repeatable strategies to drive organic growth

Conducted deep keyword, competitor, and market research to identify high intent opportunities and shape content and site structure

Partnered with product teams and project managers to implement SEO requirements across builds, launches, and ongoing optimizations

Reviewed and improved site architecture, navigation, and template structure to strengthen crawlability, indexation, and user experience

Created new page designs and optimized on-page elements (titles, headings, internal links, schema, content structure) to improve rankings and CTR

Built and strengthened link profiles through outreach, partnerships, and link reclamation to increase authority

Worked directly with clients to define project scopes, timelines, and success metrics, ensuring expectations and outcomes stayed aligned

Analyzed campaign performance and iterated on strategy based on results, driving measurable improvements and long-term growth

positions.title: SEO Manager
positions.description:
Led SEO strategy across 10+ brands, owning performance, roadmap, and execution end to end

Managed organic growth for a portfolio exceeding 10M+ monthly visits, prioritizing high impact initiatives by revenue and opportunity size

Ran full-funnel keyword research and SERP analysis to map intent, identify gaps, and build content plans that improved rankings and qualified traffic

Partnered with writers, editors, designers, and developers to ship SEO improvements across templates, internal linking, and on-page optimization

Drove technical SEO audits and fixes including indexation, crawl efficiency, redirects, canonicals, sitemap hygiene, and Core Web Vitals improvements

Built scalable SOPs for on-page SEO, content briefs, publishing workflows, and QA checks to improve speed and consistency across brands

Implemented reporting in Google Search Console and GA4 to track KPIs, diagnose drops, and communicate wins and priorities to stakeholders

Optimized existing content through refreshes, consolidation, pruning, and snippet targeting to improve CTR and capture more SERP real estate

Led link acquisition and digital PR support efforts through partnerships, content promotion, and reclamation to strengthen authority

Coordinated cross-functional SEO projects, keeping stakeholders aligned on timelines, blockers, and measurable outcomes

positions.title: SEO Associate
positions.description:
As an SEO Associate, I implemented and managed search engine optimization strategies to enhance website performance and drive measurable results. This included executing SEO tactics such as keyword research, content and metadata optimization, campaign performance tracking, and link building. Collaborating with the Content Manager and Marketing partners, I developed content strategies for newly acquired properties to align with business goals and user needs.

In this role, I performed ongoing keyword discovery and optimization while analyzing site strategies with a focus on conversions. I adhered to compliance guidelines, avoiding black hat techniques to ensure the long-term success of customer websites. Additionally, I evaluated campaign effectiveness through metrics like keyword rankings, geo-targeting, site traffic, and backlinks, presenting actionable recommendations to improve results. I also contributed to the department by implementing best practices for workflow, communication, and tracking KPIs to streamline operations and reporting.

positions.title: Applications Specialist
positions.description:
As an Applications Specialist, I managed and optimized software and database solutions to support marketing, recruiting, and operational needs. I developed and executed outbound campaigns for Puerto Rico and United States campuses using tools like Aspect software, Blackboard Connect, and OneMobileGroup. Additionally, I created and designed landing pages for marketing and recruiting initiatives to enhance engagement and improve campaign effectiveness.

In this role, I planned and implemented capacity expansions to ensure database scalability, diagnosed and resolved database access and performance issues, and monitored execution times to maintain optimal performance. I worked with systems such as Banner and Evisions Argos and designed database tables for new software modules. My responsibilities also included creating reports to track call center productivity and campaign performance, researching and proposing software aligned with emerging technologies, and reviewing database designs to recommend improvements for better efficiency. My technical expertise and proactive problem-solving contributed to the company’s overall success and operational growth.

positions.title: Server Manager
positions.description:
Served as Server Manager overseeing the maintenance, performance, and security of both Windows and Linux server environments. Managed server installation, configuration, and upgrades virtual infrastructures (VMware/Hyper-V), ensuring 99.9% system uptime. Regularly monitored server health and resolved technical issues quickly to minimize downtime and maintain smooth operations. Applied updates, patches, and implemented hardening protocols to safeguard against security threats.

Led the planning and execution of backup and disaster recovery procedures, guaranteeing data integrity and rapid recovery in the event of outages. Worked cross-functionally with IT teams and stakeholders to support business-critical applications. Documented server architecture, configurations, and resolution procedures for internal knowledge sharing. Successfully improved server performance and efficiency, reducing response times by 30% through strategic optimizations.

positions.title: Digital Marketing Specialist
positions.description:
Designed, developed, tested, and deployed web applications aligned to business needs, improving functionality and user experience

Spearheaded a full website redesign, incorporating SEO best practices that significantly increased daily traffic

Built and maintained reliable systems through periodic testing, monitoring, and contingency planning to minimize downtime

Wrote clean, efficient code structures to solve specific tasks and improve site performance and maintainability

Proposed and evaluated software solutions aligned with emerging technologies to future-proof systems and workflows

Collaborated with cross-functional teams to format, develop, and deploy web content on schedule

Managed intranet updates and ongoing site changes, ensuring consistency, accuracy, and a smooth user experience

Executed SEO tactics including keyword evaluation, metadata optimization, internal linking, and link building to increase visibility

Tracked campaign and website performance, translating insights into technical and SEO improvements that drove organic growth

company.name: Carrión Sánchez, LLC (formerly Carrión Nevárez, LLC)

positions.title: Digital Marketing Specialist
positions.description:
As a Web Developer, I was responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining web applications to support business objectives and enhance functionality. I conducted regular system testing, implemented contingency plans, and redesigned the company website to improve user experience while integrating SEO strategies that significantly increased daily traffic. I also researched and proposed software solutions aligned with emerging technologies to future-proof systems and ensure optimal performance.

In addition to development, I collaborated with cross-functional teams to create, format, and deploy engaging content while managing updates and improvements for the company intranet. I provided ongoing support and maintenance for websites and led SEO campaigns that boosted search engine rankings and organic traffic, strengthening the company’s digital presence.

positions.title: Web developer
positions.description:
I was responsible for developing, enhancing, and maintaining the company’s websites (MIUMET, MIUNE, and MITURABO), including content customization and technical support. I also took sole ownership of a special project to design and launch new student portals for these universities, ensuring they met both user and institutional needs. This project involved end-to-end development, troubleshooting, and collaboration with stakeholders to create a seamless and user-friendly experience for new students.

Additionally, I designed and generated presentations and reports for various assignments, managed documentation requirements, and provided technical assistance for web design and development. I was responsible for troubleshooting errors and ensuring the smooth functionality of websites while maintaining performance and reliability. My work directly supported the organization’s digital growth and enhanced the user experience for students and faculty alike.

positions.title: Computer Science Tutor
positions.description:
Coached students in developing their skills in Windows applications and Visual Basic, providing both group instruction and one-on-one support to enhance learning outcomes. Assisted individual students in preparing for exams, tailoring guidance to meet their unique academic needs and goals.

Completed administrative tasks such as filling out evaluations, writing progress reports, and entering payroll data accurately and on time. Actively participated in staff training sessions focused on leadership, communication, and team-building to continuously improve collaboration and teaching effectiveness.

honors.title: Outstanding Contribution in Regional Project MiUMET & MiTurabo
honors.issuer: Issued by Sistema Universitario Ana G. Méndez · Nov 2012
